_notes: 1. Vg Ps 62-67 = 思高 Ps 63-68 (offset +1 applied throughout). 2. Two entries with same key '63:6': first covers Vg 63:6a ('Súbito sagittábunt'), second covers 63:6b ('Narravérunt') — the Vulgate/Breviary splits what 思高 renders across vv.5-6. 3. Two entries also share key '63:7': first covers scrutiny of iniquities, second covers 'Accédet homo ad cor altum / exaltábitur Deus' — rendered from Latin sense as 思高 does not have an exact parallel clause for 'et exaltábitur Deus' in 64:7. 4. Two entries share key '64:5': first is 'Beátus quem elegísti', second is 'Replébimur'. 5. Two entries share key '64:10': first 'Visitásti terram', second 'Flumen Dei'. 6. 67:5a '(fit reverentia) Dóminus nomen illi': 思高 68:5 has '他名叫雅威' (YHWH); rendered as '上主是他的名号' consistent with Dóminus=上主 in psalm biblical text and the rubric bow. 7. 67:5b 'turbabúntur a fácie eius': literal 'they shall be troubled before him'; rendered as '万民在他面前将惊惶失措' — 思高 68:5 has this meaning embedded. 8. 64:12 'campi tui replebúntur ubertáte': extended slightly beyond 思高 65:12 to cover the Vulgate phrase about fields being filled with abundance; 思高 v.12 says '你的脚步常滴流脂油' only.
